## I Am Currently Looking For

::: {.callout-tip appearance="simple"}
### 🔬 Research Collaborators
I am assembling a team for an upcoming research project on [theme — placeholder]. If you work on urban resilience, climate adaptation, or spatial data science and are looking for a collaborative project, I'd love to hear from you.
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
### 🏛️ Municipal & Practice Partners
I am interested in partnerships with municipalities and public organizations where rigorous spatial analysis can inform planning, policy, and climate adaptation strategies. If you are working on urban challenges that need a data-driven perspective, let's talk.
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
### 🎓 Academic Partners
Open to research collaborations, joint grant applications, and co-supervision of doctoral research in areas related to urban resilience, spatial data science, and climate adaptation.
:::
